API Reference

The session is
one struct.

MATLAB help zeffiro_interface is the authoritative argument list. The records below are the public objects the project documents for scripting. Source links go to the official GitHub repository.

zeffiro_interface

Launch and CLI. Adds src/, plugins/, profile/, and assets/ to the path and opens the core tools. Name-value arguments include start_mode, import_to_new_project, and zeffiro_restart.

zeffiro_interface.m →

zef

Session struct in the base workspace. Documented fields used by inversion include zef.L, zef.measurements, zef.source_positions, zef.source_directions, and zef.reconstruction.

Wiki overview →

zef_inverse_run

Programmatic inverse dispatch. Constructs inverse.*Inverter classes (MNE, eLORETA, IAS, RAMUS, Kalman, HALpR, Group Lasso, UKF-NMM, and others registered in the method table).

Method list →

zeffiro_setup / zeffiro_downloader

Optional git submodules and a fresh-install helper. The wiki install page is the public setup guide.
